configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared settings: Clang + Ninja, per-preset build/install dirs. Compilers are looked up on PATH so the presets are portable across machines.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized build with debug info; generic CPU.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build that runs on any x86-64 CPU. Use when the build host differs from the run host.

configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: Optimized for the building machine's exact CPU (-march=native). This project always builds where the model runs, so this is the default for real runs.
